extension.summary: Personalised watchlists made from whatever you're in the mood for
extension.description: Tell curatr what you're in the mood for and it will create a watchlist shaped around your preferences. Create and refresh lists, organise lightweight Widget Folders, hide recommendations you do not want, and optionally connect Trakt, TMDB and MDBList. Choose from OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter or another compatible AI service.
extension.disclaimer: curatr sends prompts and likes / dislikes information to the services you enable. API keys and Trakt tokens are stored locally by Kodi and are never included in curatr backups.
extension.news:
0.17.0~beta5 (2026-08-22) - Adds lightweight Widget Folders containing references to existing curatr lists. - Adds direct external plugin shortcuts without copying or proxying their content. - Gives folders and external shortcuts independent icon, fanart and description choices. - Adds stable per-folder widget paths, ordering, safe stale-reference handling and backup support. - Uses no AI, Trakt, TMDB or background polling for Widget Folders.
0.16.0~beta4 (2026-08-22) - Keeps every AI provider visible while greying out settings for providers that are not selected. - Accepts copied TMDB read tokens with optional Bearer text, quotes or line wrapping. - Clarifies that Settings must be saved before checking a newly entered TMDB credential. - Shows Fanart Style only when Automatic or bundled curatr fanart is selected. - Shows the selected film or person name instead of technical Item/Person artwork labels. - Adds one-time matching between corresponding icon and fanart selections, including custom images. - Stops list creation cleanly when required dialogs are cancelled and confirms before spending AI tokens. - Completes Kodi directory handling before refreshing widgets to reduce skin flicker and instability. - Prevents background updates or active dialogs from forcing a full skin reload. - Ensures generated repository ZIPs are not excluded from Git commits.
0.16.0~beta3 (2026-08-22) - Makes menus, settings, descriptions and setup messages clearer and more consistent. - Uses Preferences throughout the interface while leaving stable internal state unchanged. - Adds friendly per-list refresh and Trakt sync interval choices. - Cleans and validates the GitHub Pages repository build and packaged assets.
0.16.0~beta2 (2026-08-22) - Publishes versioned add-on icon and fanart files for Kodi repository browsing.
0.16.0~beta1 (2026-08-21) - Renames the canonical Kodi add-on ID to plugin.video.curatr. - Force-refreshes skin widgets after list creation, editing, refresh, restore or deletion. - Adds an optional user-facing description for each list and its widget entry. - Removes the curatr logo and wordmark from the in-menu background.
0.15.2 (2026-08-21) - Replaces the earlier drawn list artwork with approved generated designs. - Adds 17 generated square icons and matching colour and monochrome fanarts. - Uses versioned artwork paths to prevent stale Kodi texture-cache results.
0.15.1 (2026-08-21) - Keeps the centred branded artwork on Kodi's main add-on page. - Adds separate right-aligned in-menu fanart with clear space for Kodi labels. - Uses a new menu-art filename to avoid stale Kodi texture-cache results.
0.15.0 (2026-08-21) - Adds independent per-list square icons and landscape fanart. - Adds bundled genre and person artwork in colour and monochrome styles. - Adds optional TMDB and MDBList enrichment plus Claude and OpenRouter support. - Organises Trakt/MDBList under Linked Accounts and TMDB under Metadata.
0.14.1 - Adds clearer settings wording and improved provider configuration guidance.
0.13.3 - Adds duplicate-aware backup restore and preserves restored-list safety.
